notes: CB3 changes fixtures only. Production code remains the tested CB2 implementation.
Control setup writes 59 patterned rows into the 30-row model, reaching origin 2320; the tested final byte scrolls to origin zero exactly once.

Fixture-only snapshots verify unchanged origin, generation and all physical cells while READ replies with a scroll pending. One variant injects translated input immediately after real launch and invokes the existing worker ReadQuantum in that turn to require hardware BUSY/READ overlap in raw and optimized builds; other variants keep the existing client-side delivery and worker scheduling. This is a functional overlap probe, not a production scheduling or timing claim. Physical keyboard/SIO/ST overlap is measured by CB4.

The probe waits for snapshot verification separately from ReplyMsg, and explicitly wakes the worker when releasing a held completion notification. It allocates/frees its temporary 2400-byte snapshot only for pending-DMA variants.
All 13 control variants pass in both modes: prelaunch/pending cancellation, stale unit/view/model identity, hide/show, last-WRITE stop, instance destruction/reuse and PRESENTING deferral.
All six fault variants pass in both modes; scroll faults are armed after 29 warm-up scrolls, and reset-required retention preserves the committed wrap.
Window lifetime/isolation and owner-removal guards pass three scenarios in each mode; repeated wrapped output precedes retirement, and CMD_CLEAR preserves the character origin.

CB2 pixel scenes additionally cover nonzero-origin partial-row edits, caret restoration, hidden repeated wrapping, focus, odd tile widths and neighbor isolation. CB1 covers seeded clipped text and CPU bank crossing.
The 321-test host run includes the pre-existing cartridge checks present in the workspace; cartridge changes are outside these commits.
No production IRQ, scheduling, ownership or lifetime policy was changed. All bank-zero deltas include guards, padding and unused capacity. No baseline execution or full release qualification.
